# Core contract fixtures

`v0.2` holds synthetic illustrative `hammerhead-core/v0.2` reports for completed, partial, failed and cancelled outcomes. They carry the Core product/scope fields, six included check records and explicit GIT-002 non-evaluation. They are examples, not captured runs.

`internal/reporter/testdata/v0.2` holds serializer goldens from synthetic `ScanResult` inputs. Some of those unit inputs intentionally contain minimal or unknown telemetry. Executable-level `TestCore_*` and native engine acceptance tests assert production six-check coverage, exact scope, limits, status and exits. Historical full-product v0.1 fixtures are not part of this Core workspace or acceptance count; the protected original retains them.
